content.text: {"id": "mm7303a3", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "During 2009–2022, 93 U.S. citizens died after receiving cosmetic surgery in the Dominican Republic."}, {"loc": "summary", "q": "The number of deaths increased from a mean of 4.1 per year during 2009–2018 to a mean of 13.0 during 2019–2022"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "count/rate", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The number of deaths varied from one to 17 per year, with the peak in 2020"}]}, {"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Fat embolism was the cause of death in 11 (55%) of 20 cases"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Among 23 decedents with information on BMI available, 22 (96%) had overweight or obesity"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "The number of deaths increased from a mean of 4.1 per year during 2009–2018 to a mean of 13.0 during 2019–2022"}, {"loc": "table 1", "q": "Total no. of decedents,24 (100),10 (40),14 (60)"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "outbreak investigation", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "CDC launched an investigation to identify the etiology and epidemiology of and preventable risk factors for death"}]}, {"v": "before/after or trend", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "The number of deaths increased from a mean of 4.1 per year during 2009–2018 to a mean of 13.0 during 2019–2022"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "CDC analyzed the number of deaths collected by the Consular Section at the U.S. Embassy"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "conducted a review of available medical and autopsy reports provided by the MOH during 2019–2020"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "extracted information on known risk factors for perioperative death"}], "confidence": "medium", "uncertain_fields": ["study_design"]}
